SaveName: Dark Magic Card Game for Kids

0.title: Rules
0.body:
Objective:

You win the game when you make all your opponents take all their Wounds before you do. 

Setup:

Shuffle the shared Fate deck.
Deal 7 face down 'Wounds' to each player.
Each player draws 5.
Discarded cards go to the 'Void'.
If Fate deck runs out, shuffle the Void in.
Randomly choose who takes the 1st turn.
Set an empty bag for challenges.
Give colored counters to each player.

Gameplay:

During a turn each player does this in order:

1. Sacrifice: You may sacrifice a Daemon you control. Put it in the Void.

2. Summon: You can summon a Daemon from your hand. A Greater Daemon can only be summoned if you sacrificed a Daemon in the Sacrifice Step.

3. Power Up: Put counters in the challenge bag, equal to your Daemon's total Power. 

4. Attack: You may challenge an opponent. If you win this challenge, that opponent takes a Wound. If you lose, you take a Wound. You can't do this if this on the first turn of the game.

5. Draw: Draw a card.

Spells:

Before any step, players have a chance to cast spells from their hand, starting with the active player and going in turn order.

Players can respond to spells with other spells of their own. Resolve them in reverse order 

Challenges: 

To challenge an opponent, pull random counters from the challenge bag until you pull two of the same  color. The player whose color it is wins the challenge. The other player loses.

Challenges can be used in the Attack step to make the opponent take Wounds, but may also be called on for other purposes.

More Power:

Some Daemon's abilities and Spells can grant you Power. When they do, put that many counters immediately into the bag.

function onLoad()
    print("Prepare challenge")
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "challenge",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Challenge",
        position       = {3, 1, 0},
        rotation       = {0, 270, 0},
        width          = 1600,
        height         = 800,
        font_size      = 340,
        color          = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    })
end

function challenge(obj, color, alt_click)
    if obj.getQuantity() >= 1 then
        obj.shuffle()
        self.takeObject({
            position = {x=3, y=7, z=0},
            callback_function = function(obj) take_callback(obj, futureName) end,
        })
        self.reset()
        self.setDescription("Empty")
    end
end

function take_callback(object_spawned, name)
    if object_spawned["name"] == "Go Game Piece White" then
        print("White wins the challenge.")
    elseif object_spawned["name"] == "Go Game Piece Black" then
        print("Black wins the challenge.")
    end
end

-- Shuffle the challenge bag each time a piece is put inside
function onObjectEnterContainer(bag, obj)
    print("Piece received")
    black = 0
    white = 0
    for i, piece in pairs(bag.getObjects()) do
        if piece["name"] == "Go Game Piece White" then
            white = white + 1
        elseif piece["name"] == "Go Game Piece Black" then
            black = black + 1
        end
    end
    self.setDescription("Black: " .. black .. ", White: " .. white)
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
INITIAL_HAND = 5
INITIAL_WOUNDS = 9

function onLoad()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "start_game",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Start\nGame",
        position       = {0, 0, -2.5},
        rotation       = {180, 0, 0},
        width          = 1000,
        height         = 800,
        font_size      = 340,
        color          = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    })
end

function start_game(obj, color, alt_click)
    self.shuffle()
    colors = Player.getAvailableColors()
    print("Player colors:")
    print(colors)
    for i, color in pairs(colors) do
        print("Dealing hand to " .. color)
        self.deal(INITIAL_HAND, color)
        print("Dealing wounds to " .. color)
        add_wounds(self, INITIAL_WOUNDS, color)
    end
end

-- Add face-down wound cards to a player from the deck
function add_wounds(source, num, color)
    for var=1,num do
        source.dealToColorWithOffset({12,0,4}, false, color)
    end
end
